summary: Phase 149O.10 -- HATP Signing Ceremony + Evidence Store Contract Independent Verification: verification-only phase (no production implementation, no HATP-001/RAE-001/HSCE-001 amendment, no CLI implementation, no hardware provisioning, no signing execution, no Permission Broker change, no rollback dispatch behavior change). Ran the full required initial inspection (git status/log, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.9) and confirmed the expected baseline: 149O.9 completed/complete/pushed/consistent, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read HSCE-001 (full text, independently, not trusting 149O.9's own summary), HATP-001 (full text), and every named HATP/RAE core source module (human_approval_trusted_provenance.py, hatp_providers.py, hatp_ag_authority.py, rollback_approval_evidence.py, core/agent.py, commands/agent.py, cli.py, decision_session.py) plus a dedicated research pass gathering exact file:line excerpts for every claim HSCE-001 makes against current source. Independently re-derived the requirement inventory by regex extraction of every HSCE-REQ-### token in the contract text (not the contract's own closing count): found 79 requirements, HSCE-REQ-001 through HSCE-REQ-079, sequential/gapless/no-duplicates -- HSCE-REQ-078 itself claims the contract defines 'HSCE-REQ-001 through HSCE-REQ-078 inclusive,' but HSCE-REQ-079 exists afterward in section 40; a non-blocking editorial miscounting (Finding F-1), not an implementation ambiguity. Independently re-confirmed HATP-001 and RAE-001 compatibility (both contract files byte-unchanged over the last 20 commits via git diff; no conflicting redefinition of proof shape, digest, verification vocabulary, 24h freshness TTL, or evidence-store semantics). Independently re-confirmed the AG5/AG3 CLI entry-point inventory unchanged against the current source tree: pcae rollback --per-id <id> [--dry-run] [--json] (run_rollback, src/pcae/commands/agent.py:16259) remains the sole production call site reaching build_rollback_execution with no HATP arguments; build_rollback_execution_pilot() reconfirmed as a non-calling false-positive name collision; zero hits for 'hatp sign'/HATPSignedEvidenceEnvelope anywhere in src/pcae/cli.py or src/pcae/commands/, confirming no signing-command implementation exists yet. Attacked all 20 items of HSCE-001 section 38's mandatory attack matrix individually, cross-referencing each against contract text and source, and independently identified three additional findings beyond the matrix: F-2 (HSCE-REQ-052 claims to reuse rollback_approval_evidence.py::_write_atomic_json 'as-is,' but that function -- independently read in full -- has no symlink check at all, so HSCE-REQ-057/058 cannot be satisfied by literal unmodified reuse; non-blocking, a reuse-precision gap), and the phase's central finding, F-3 (BLOCKING): HSCE-REQ-052's frozen no-clobber write algorithm ('existence-and-compare check MUST happen first, and the atomic rename is used only for the create-new-file case') is a check-then-act pattern, not an atomically-exclusive publish -- os.replace() on POSIX is unconditional and silently replaces an existing destination regardless of the earlier existence check's result, so two concurrent writers racing to persist differing envelopes for the same evidence_id can each observe 'absent' before either writes, and the second writer's unconditional os.replace() silently overwrites the first with no evidence_conflict rejection, directly violating security invariant SC-7 ('existing evidence can never be silently overwritten... always rejected, never replaced'). Independently confirmed this is not hypothetical: rollback_approval_evidence.py's own _write_atomic_json has the identical check-then-act shape and is only safe today because RAE-001's create_rollback_approval_binding additionally writes a separate, genuinely atomic creation-registry/{evidence_id} marker via os.open(path, O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_WRONLY) (write_creation_registration, rollback_approval_evidence.py:664) -- an exclusive-create primitive HSCE-001 section 20 (HSCE-REQ-042) explicitly declines to require for HATP evidence, reasoning about a different threat (out-of-band bypass) than the concurrent-legitimate-writers race this phase identified. Recorded three further non-blocking observations: Obs-1 (create_production_hardware_provider's real signature has an allow_piv_fallback parameter HSCE-REQ-022 does not address), Obs-2 (the mandatory attack matrix has no AG3-analogue of item 20's AG5 ecp_id-resolution-failure case; semantics already unambiguous via the shared operation_not_found error_type), and Obs-3 (independent re-run of 149O.9's own targeted regression sweep, on 149O.9's own final commit 39ccfc11 via git stash -u before/after comparison, reproduces 10 pre-existing failures both times, not the 9 that phase's report claimed -- same 10-item set stable and reproducible, unconnected to HSCE-001). Every other HSCE-001 section -- CLI grammar, AG3/AG5 locators, proof field-source table, envelope schema, version-domain bool-rejection, provider-assertion Base64 encoding, evidence-ID formula and content-addressing, path-traversal/case-alias/symlink-file/symlink-root validation, closed-schema attacks (duplicate keys, unknown fields, missing fields, digest mismatch), human-cancellation/device-absence/TOCTOU/missing-Binding/ecp_id-resolution handling, closed error vocabulary and exit-code mapping, secret handling, authority separation, and 11 of 12 security invariants (SC-1 through SC-6, SC-8 through SC-12) -- independently confirmed complete, internally coherent, and sufficiently precise for implementation without ambiguity; none reopened. New independent suite tests/test_phase_149o_10_hatp_signing_ceremony_evidence_store_contract_independent_verification.py: 27 passed, re-typing every critical frozen expectation independently (CLI grammar, schema field set, error vocabulary, 20-item attack-matrix count, SC-1..12 presence, AG5 inventory, F-2/F-3's structural source evidence, HATP-001's 13-member status vocabulary, decision_session.py's many-to-few exit-code convention) rather than importing 149O.9's own constants. 149O.9's own suite reconfirmed unaffected (60 passed). Fast Green: 4590 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed -- byte-identical to 149O.9's own baseline, confirming no collateral regression from this phase's doc/test-only changes. No production code modified. HATP-001 v1.0, RAE-001 v1.0, and HSCE-001 v1.0 remain byte-unchanged. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Separately, unrelated to HSCE-001 and not implemented this phase: during this session's pcae session bootstrap invocation, found a latent defect in src/pcae/commands/session.py::_classify_bootstrap_readiness (passes the just-completed phase's own id into _phase_is_completed instead of the active task's phase id, causing a permanent false 'Active task appears stale' block on every bootstrap immediately following any phase close) and planned a narrow future repair task for it (title/scope only, no src/pcae/** change made). CONTRACT VERDICT: NOT VERIFIED -- BLOCKING HSCE-001 CONTRACT FINDING (F-3). Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_10_HATP_SIGNING_CEREMONY_EVIDENCE_STORE_CONTRACT_INDEPENDENT_VERIFICATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.10.1, HSCE-001 Narrow Contract Repair (HSCE-REQ-052 only).
